issues.title: Stop could update DB state without draining active workers
issues.rootCause: The runner returned from DB stopped/cancelled and bus stop paths after aborting workers without terminalizing Active workspaces through the drain path.
issues.fixSummary: Added public stop drain entrypoint, called it from DB stopped/cancelled and bus stop paths, and emitted stop drain events.

issues.title: Late worker completion could attempt Pending to Succeeded/Complete
issues.rootCause: Old executor promises could complete after Continue reset the workspace to Pending, and not every completion path reloaded DB truth before transitioning.
issues.fixSummary: Added DB-truth stale completion guard before completion transitions and emitted stale/illegal-prevented diagnostics.

issues.title: Recovery deleted snapshots required for Continue
issues.rootCause: Crash recovery cleaned queue/meta snapshots for failed, stopped, and cancelled plans even though manual Continue needs them.
issues.fixSummary: Preserved snapshots for failed/stopped/cancelled executions and added explicit Continue errors for queue/metadata missing.

issues.title: Active registry could diverge from PostgreSQL plan state
issues.rootCause: The runner trusted the active execution registry in some paths and did not emit diagnostics when PostgreSQL said stopped/cancelled.
issues.fixSummary: PostgreSQL stopped/cancelled now wins, runner drains active work, and mismatch events are journaled.

issues.title: Dashboard lacked control-plane health visibility
issues.rootCause: The run view showed plan/workspace data but not stop drain, stale completion, mismatch, or stream health diagnostics.
issues.fixSummary: Added a minimal Execution Stability / Control Plane Health panel, connection status from the SSE hook, and a worker Pi CLI raw log tab with live assistant text chunks.

issues.title: Continue errors were generic
issues.rootCause: The rerun route collapsed queue-missing, no-resettable, and unrecoverable states into one generic message.
issues.fixSummary: Added explicit no-resettable and queue/metadata-missing responses and surfaced them in the dashboard error banner/panel.

issues.title: Long-term execution service split remains needed
issues.rootCause: Execution lifecycle, dashboard routes, and runner registry remain physically coupled.
issues.fixSummary: Reported only. No package extraction or large architecture rewrite was done.
